subject: [PATCH v6 RESEND 3/5] mm/page_counter: make page_counter_try_charge() stock-aware

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the page_counter_try_charge() function to be stock-aware, allowing it to consume stock transparently while preserving the same semantics as try_charge_memcg's greedy charge attempt and refill behavior. The function now takes two new parameters: may_batch, which preserves the behavior of !allow_spinning scenarios, and nr_charged, which reflects the size of the successful hierarchy charge. This change is intended to improve memory.high accounting for current->memcg_nr_pages_over_high without affecting existing functionality.
